slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain that wakes you at night

caption:
Sparky, chippy, plumber or painter: by Friday, a lot of tradies feel every job. Overhead work loads the shoulders, all-day gripping tires the forearms, and bending and lifting land in the lower back.

Remedial massage can ease that tight, worn-out feeling for a while. Pair it with a few stretches at smoko and some strength work twice a week, and your body has a better shot at keeping up with the job.

Pins and needles in the hands, pain at night or a specific injury on the job should be assessed first.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio work alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio 🔧

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
